reasons: C1-C3 bind to ac<N>-* nodes; the run exits 0 with all three screenshots captured through capture-helper.
C3 asserts the toggle in both directions by observable effect (limit-price-input visible after Limit, hidden after Market), not by DOM presence alone.
Screenshots were read back and show real controller-backed state: live balance, live ETH price with candles, and the Limit pill selected with the limit price field on-screen.

C4 is deliberately proven off-recipe by yarn lint:tsc plus translate-perps-error.test.ts (41 passed); no extension UI path can emit the 15 new PerpsErrorCode values, so a recipe assertion would have to fake the error.

graph_integrity.reason: Recipe v1 graph validates; every node is reachable from gate-unlock and terminates at done. No switch/default, no manual action, no wait-as-substitute-for-wait_for.

action_contract.reason: Only manifest-declared actions are used (metamask.wallet.ensure_unlocked, ui.navigate, ui.wait_for, ui.press, ui.screenshot, metamask.wallet.read_state, end), each with fields the action manifest declares. Navigation uses the high-level page aliases perps and perps-market rather than raw hashes.

ac_coverage.reason: Three proofTargets, each bound to ac<N>-* nodes via proves. C4 is recorded as proven off-recipe with a concrete rationale rather than silently skipped.

evidence_contract_basics.reason: Every screenshot follows a ui.wait_for on the claimed target. All three PNGs were read back and show the claimed state on the right screen, fully visible. Artifact manifest records provider capture-helper — no extension-dom-raster, macos-screencapture, or Page.captureScreenshot fallback.

revert_sensitivity.reason: The change is a dependency bump plus two compile-only fixes, so reverting it breaks the build rather than flipping a recipe assertion. The recipe proves no regression on the perps surfaces; the compile and unit gates prove the fix. This is stated plainly in recipe-coverage.md instead of being papered over.

perps_state_setup.reason: The slot account already carries a funded HyperLiquid balance ($762.37 at capture time) and trade history, so the recipe exercises populated surfaces rather than empty states. No AC was marked untestable for missing state.

contextual_findings.message: C4 (exhaustive PerpsErrorCode translation) cannot be exercised from the extension UI; it is proven by the `as const satisfies Record<PerpsErrorCode, string>` compile gate and the runtime exhaustiveness test rather than by a recipe node.

The run reports 3 console error fingerprints (`Unknown action`, resource 404s, ExtensionLazyListener runtime.onInstalled). All three appear in extension-console.log at 09:42 against the pre-change build, so they are pre-existing slot noise rather than regressions.

suggested_recipe_delta: If the extension later exposes trigger orders or partial TP/SL, add ac4-* nodes that drive a rejected placement and assert the translated copy for the new ORDER_TPSL_* / ORDER_TRIGGER_* codes.

good_patterns: toggle asserted in both directions by observable effect rather than by pressed-state DOM attribute
compile-time claim reported as off-recipe proof instead of being padded with a screenshot
